correctness.rationale: For N=2^k≥4, common difference gcd g reduces to primitive m=N/g with an injective phase map k↦(exp(−2πiku/m),exp(−2πikv/m)). The cancellation w0+w1X+w2Y=0 with positive real weights has either exactly two conjugate solutions for X,Y when triangle inequalities are strict, or only antipodal phases ±1 in the degenerate case. Injectivity gives either 2g zeros at t and −t, or g zeros at the unique primitive order-two residue m/2; other weights have zero zeros. The m=4 fourth-root geometry has no strictly enclosing triangle, hence only g=N/4; for m≥8, 2g≤N/4. Equality requires (m=4, degeneracy) or (m=8, strict triangle). Roots of (1+z)^2 and 1+sqrt2 z+z² at the specified fourth/eighth roots certify sharpness. Recomputed exact cyclotomic reduction on 2970 weighted/support configurations and checked analytic triangle argument; no finite enumeration substitutes for the proof.
